event_properties.content: How many 1-star reviews did I get this week?

You received **8 one-star reviews** this week — 5 on Zomato, 2 on Swiggy, and 1 on Google. I've flagged the top 3 most detailed ones for your review. Would you like me to draft response templates for them?
Which platform has my worst ratings?

**Swiggy** has your lowest average at 3.6 ★. The primary drivers are delivery time complaints and packaging issues — both of which are delivery-specific problems. Your restaurant ratings (Google, Dineout) are significantly higher at 4.0+.
